chooseParent: Choose where to save this workspace
selectionHint: Click to toggle · Shift range · Ctrl+A all
privateBody: Your documents stay on your device.
title: From page to possibility.
subtitle: Turn documents, photos and screenshots into editable text.
instructionsPlaceholder: For example: keep the original language and preserve table column order.
instructionsHint: Applied to each OCR request. Results can vary with the document and model.
layoutHint: Keep region positions and reading order
fullPageHint: Read the whole page in one pass
comicHint: Add a reading direction to your instructions, such as right to left.
dropBody: Add PDFs, scanned pages, photos or screenshots. You can add several files at once.
featureScan: Whole page or region by region
featureScanBody: Choose the scan approach for your document.
editHint: Your scan results appear here. You can edit them freely.
rawHint: The unedited model response will appear here.
structureHint: Select a region to inspect its position and text.
noStructure: Run a scan to see the document structure.
readyBody: Select pages and scan. Change the mode or instructions and retry anytime.
scanningBody: Results are saved as the scan completes.
heading: Heading
languageHint: The installer language is used on the first launch.
dataHint: Settings, models, logs and new workspaces are stored here. Change this location by running the installer.
paddleDescription: Multilingual documents, tables, formulas and scanned text.
cudaHint: Automatic prepares one compatible GPU engine, or uses the included CPU engine. CUDA needs an NVIDIA GPU and compatible driver.
modelDownloadHint: Models download from Hugging Face on first use. Your files stay on this device.
repositoryHint: Use owner/repository. Official release builds include their source repository automatically.
updateHint: The installer will open so you can review data retention options.
updateIdle: Check GitHub Releases for a new version.
downloadFootnote: Progress is kept, even after you close the app.
browserPreview: Preview mode. Open the desktop app to recognize your files.
desktopRequired: Open the desktop app to use this feature.
invalidTokens: Output length must be between 512 and 16,384 tokens.
longInstructions: Instructions must be at most 4,000 characters.
outsideProject: Files outside the workspace cannot be accessed.
interruptedPage: This scan was interrupted. You can scan the page again.
pageLimit: A workspace can contain up to 1,000 pages. Create a new workspace.
pageLimitShort: A workspace can contain up to 1,000 pages.
unsupportedFile: Add a PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP or BMP file.
fileTooLarge: File too large. Images: up to 100 MB; PDFs: up to 1 GB.
clipboardEmpty: No image on the clipboard. Copy an image and try again.
clipboardInvalid: The clipboard image could not be read.
engineNotRunning: The OCR engine is not running.
emptyResponse: The OCR response did not contain text.
outputTruncated: Output limit reached. Increase the token limit and scan again to recover missing content.
emptyRecognition: No text recognized. Check the source and recognition mode.
importPartial: Some files could not be added.
resultTooLarge: A page result can be up to 4 MB.
regionWarnings: Some regions have warnings. Review them in the Structure tab.
noRegions: No regions detected; the whole page was recognized instead. Comics and unusual layouts may be missed.
scanCancelled: Scan stopped. Completed results have been saved.
invalidExport: Choose TXT, Markdown, JSON or HTML.
downloadCancelled: Download stopped. It will resume on the next scan.
modelHashMismatch: Downloaded file verification failed. Scan again to download that file afresh.
modelTooLarge: The server returned a file larger than expected.
downloadInterrupted: The connection ended before the download completed.
rangeMismatch: The resumed download range does not match.
tableTextOutside: Review text outside table rows in the raw output.
tableMergedText: Review merged-cell text in the raw output.
tableIncomplete: Incomplete table rows or columns. The raw output has been preserved.
pdfOpenError: Cannot open PDF. Unlock encrypted PDFs before importing: {0}
downloadFailed:
Download failed: {0}
Check your connection and resume.
engineStartError:
Could not start OCR engine. {0}
Logs: {1}
processExit: The engine exited ({0}). Check the log file.
modelUnknown: This OCR model is not installed.
futureSettings: These settings were created by a newer app version.
invalidRepository: Enter a GitHub repository as owner/repository.
unsafeDataPath: Choose a normal folder dedicated to FastFileOCR data.
unownedDataPath: This folder contains other files. Choose an empty folder or an existing FastFileOCR data folder.
previousOpenError: Could not open the previous workspace: {0}
updateNoInstaller: The release has no compatible Windows installer.
updateNoChecksum: The release has no valid checksum file.
updateInvalidAsset: The update asset does not match its expected source or size.
updateHashMismatch: Update verification failed. Download it again.
installDataDescription: Where should FastFileOCR store settings and models?
installDataHint: Choose a folder for settings, models and workspaces. When it already contains other files, a dedicated FastFileOCR subfolder is created. The final location is shown before installation.
installModeDescription: Choose how to initialize your settings.
installModeHint: Both options keep downloaded models and documents. Reset settings are backed up before the first launch.
installKeep: Keep existing settings and migrate their format (recommended)
installUnsafe: Choose an empty folder or a marked FastFileOCR data folder. System folders and symbolic links cannot be used.
installWriteError: The data folder is not writable. Choose another location.
installResetConfirm: Reset existing settings? A backup will be kept. Models and documents will remain.
uninstallData: Also remove application settings, downloaded models and GPU engines, logs and update files? Your document workspaces will be kept unless you choose to remove them next.
uninstallDocuments: Also permanently delete document workspaces stored inside this application's data folder? This cannot be undone. Documents stored elsewhere are not affected.
uninstallUnsafe: Data was kept because its folder contains links or could not be verified as application-owned.
webviewStartError: Could not start the included Microsoft WebView2 installer.
webviewInstallError: Microsoft WebView2 installation failed. Restart Windows and run this installer again.
installerAppRunning: Close FastFileOCR before installing or changing its data settings.
uninstallDataHint: Unchecked items will be kept for future installations.
updateNoRelease: No public release has been published yet.
runtimeUnavailable: {0} requires a compatible GPU and driver. Choose Automatic or CPU, or update the graphics driver.
runtimeUnsafeArchive: The GPU engine archive contains invalid files.
runtimeCacheError: The GPU engine folder could not be safely updated. Check the data folder and try again.
runtimeIncomplete: The GPU engine is missing required files. Please retry.
runtimeDownloadHint: GPU engines download on first use: Vulkan about 34 MB, CUDA about 537 MB. Downloads can resume and are retained across app updates.
